definitions.timing: Rank-zero elapsed-clock difference from first pre-step record to the penultimate record; excludes initialization output and final step/final output. Intermediate ordinary solver tasks/communication included. Last physical step omitted from timing.
definitions.timed_physical_duration: Sum of printed step dt values for the timed cycles; seven-significant-digit log precision is the measurement limit. Do not subtract six-place printed absolute times.
definitions.energy: Uniform-volume native-restart integrals: kinetic=rho*v^2/2; thermal=ppar/2+pperp (passive tracer thermal energy); magnetic=native face-square average. Differences compare full coupled integrations, not an isolated LF energy budget.
definitions.error: Candidate minus explicit, uniform active-cell weights. Explicit is a lower-step comparison, not an established exact solution. No fixed acceptance tolerance imposed.

cold_state_controls.numerical_interpretation: Original strict failure reproducible. Cap4, explicit, cap14 avoid it for exactly one original outer-step duration. Cap4 agrees more closely locally; cap14 has about30% discrepancy at the originally cold cell. Neither is qualified for the full turbulent run.
cold_state_controls.source_hypothesis: LimiterCollisionRate enters LF face collision frequency; at rate1e10 it sharply switches conductivity at soft thresholds. The timestep bound deliberately uses background collisions only, so suppression is not omitted from a claimed positivity proof: no such nonlinear positivity proof exists. The probes retain this operator and thresholds.
